metadata.case_name: LEE SUK YIN AND OTHERS v. NATIONAL INSURANCE CO. LTD.

plaintiff.occupation_before: glazier apprentice in Sing Lung Curtain Wall Engineering Co.

injuries.description: burst fracture of the C6 vertebra;
source: burst fracture of the C6 vertebra;
injuries.icd_description: Fracture of other specified cervical vertebra

injuries.description: severe head injuries involving loss of consciousness, subdural haematoma, and disorientation;
source: severe head injuries involving loss of consciousness, subdural haematoma, and disorientation;

injuries.description: incomplete quadriplegic (also referred to as an incomplete tetraplegic);
source: wheelchair bound for the rest of his life as an incomplete quadriplegic (also referred to as an incomplete tetraplegic).
injuries.icd_description: Other incomplete cord syndrome of cervical spinal cord

injuries.description: "left dorsolumbar kyphoscoliosis" which is a condition involving the abnormal curving of the spine.
source: "left dorsolumbar kyphoscoliosis" which is a condition involving the abnormal curving of the spine.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injuries to the abdomen, lower back, lumbar spine or pelvis

injuries.description: spastic obstructive sphincter causing vesico-ureteric reflux which has already led to the development of reflux hydronephrosis of the kidneys.
source: spastic obstructive sphincter causing vesico-ureteric reflux (i.e. reflux of urine from the bladder to the kidney) which has already led to the development of reflux hydronephrosis of the kidneys.

injuries.description: bladder dysfunction with poor bladder sensation, urinary incontinence and incomplete voiding.
source: he has bladder dysfunction with poor bladder sensation, urinary incontinence and incomplete voiding.

injuries.description: bowel dysfunction with partial bowel sensation and very occasional incontinence.
source: He also suffers from bowel dysfunction with partial bowel sensation and very occasional incontinence.

injuries.description: sexual impotence from erectile dysfunction and total loss of sensation over the genitalia.
source: the injuries have left him sexually impotent from erectile dysfunction and total loss of sensation over the genitalia.

injuries.description: large pressure sores in his sacral region (healed).
source: During his hospitalization he had large pressure sores in his sacral region but these have healed and have not recurred.
injuries.icd_description: Open wound of abdomen, lower back or pelvis

injuries.description: complete paralysis of the trunk with grossly diminished sensation and marked muscle wasting.
source: There is complete paralysis of the trunk with grossly diminished sensation and marked muscle wasting.
injuries.icd_description: Complete lesion of lumbar spinal cord

injuries.description: complete spastic paralysis in his lower limbs with recurrent painful spasms including clonus at the patella and ankle; grossly diminished sensation and muscle wasting.
source: there is complete spastic paralysis in his lower limbs with recurrent painful spasms including clonus (i.e. rigidity and relaxation of muscles alternating in rapid succession) at the patella and ankle. His lower limbs have also grossly diminished sensation and muscle wasting.
injuries.icd_description: Complete lesion of lumbar spinal cord

injuries.description: incomplete paralysis of his upper limbs; hands and fingers have very limited grade 1 power giving no useful function with marked muscle wasting and grossly diminished sensation.
source: The 3rd plaintiff suffers from incomplete paralysis of his upper limbs.

His hands and fingers have very limited grade 1 power giving no useful function. The fingers are all held at a slightly flexed position and sensation is grossly diminished. There is also marked muscle wasting.
injuries.icd_description: Central cord syndrome of cervical spinal cord

manifestations.description: loss of consciousness
disorientation for some three months following the accident
recurrent painful spasms including clonus at the patella and ankle
grossly diminished sensation in lower limbs
muscle wasting (lower limbs, trunk, upper limbs)
persistent low back pain increasing with cramp; recurrent cramps in the lumbar region and left abdomen
urinary incontinence, incomplete voiding and poor bladder sensation
penile skin problems caused by use of Paul's tube
partial bowel sensation and very occasional incontinence managed by anal suppositories once every other day
erectile dysfunction and total loss of sensation over the genitalia
very limited hand and finger power (grade 1) giving no useful function; fingers held slightly flexed; grossly diminished sensation
hyperpathia over the whole of the upper limbs
limited range of motion of the neck for flexion, extension and rotation with persistent pain and stiffness
occasional right parietal headache
impairment of higher mental functions including retardation of thinking process and short term memory
emotional changes: occasional helplessness, frustration, irritability and anxiety; feeling of frustration at confinement and dependence
6 cm long C-shaped scar on his left parietal scalp
4 x 1.5 cm tracheostomy scar above the sternum
depressed scar 9 cm in diameter over the sacral region
dorsal scar 1 cm in diameter over the left foot
dorsal scar 2.5 cm in diameter over the right foot
scar on the right lateral malleolar ankle 1.5 cm in diameter

treatments_received: immobilisation with a halo ring and jacket
conservative treatment for subdural haematoma and lung contusion
regular follow ups at orthopaedic and urology clinics
treatments_future: ileal conduit operation or sphincterotomy (urological surgery)

losses.description: Wheelchair bound for the rest of his life as an incomplete quadriplegic.
Incomplete paralysis of upper limbs; very limited hand and finger function giving no useful function; complete spastic paralysis of lower limbs and complete paralysis of trunk.

Scars including a 6 cm C-shaped scar on left parietal scalp; 4 x 1.5 cm tracheostomy scar above the sternum; depressed scar 9 cm over sacral region; dorsal scars on left and right foot and scar on right lateral malleolar ankle.
Dependence on family and carers for care, family members provided long periods of care in hospital and at home; need for health care assistant and domestic helper.
Impairment of higher mental functions including retardation of thinking process and short term memory.

losses.category: Loss of sexual function and sexual life
losses.description: Sexual impotence from erectile dysfunction and total loss of sensation over the genitalia.

losses.category: Loss of ability to do domestic tasks
losses.description: Hands and fingers have very limited power giving no useful function, indicating loss of ability to perform ordinary household tasks.

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: Restricted from undertaking sporting, social and educational activities because of limitations in mobility.
